Commentary.Commentary: The ball is in India's court now. 163, on this surface, is a gettable one, and they should too with the kind of batting line-up they have. But, given Pakistan's attack and the pressure of the occasion, a couple of early wickets and anything can happen. Much like Pakistan's, India's middle order has shown to be frail in the past. Join us for the second half in a short while.

Kedar Jadhav is being interviewed by Ramiz Raja on the sidelines. He says that he is enjoying his bowling. Mentions that his role is to contain the batsmen and try to get in as many dot balls as possible. Adds that if he gets wickets in the process, that is a bonus. Informs that he tries to read the batsmen and bowl accordingly. On being asked whether he intentionally bowls with such a low-arm action or not, he replies that he wants it that way. States that he sticks to a wicket-to-wicket line. Adds that he doesn't give much pace on the ball so it is not easy for the batsmen to hit him around. Reckons that the ball will spin after 20-30 overs in the second innings. Ends by saying that they need to go out there and get the runs.

Credit to the Indian bowlers, they were exceptional right from the start. It was a collective effort. Kumar started things off, then Kuldeep followed by breaking that all-important partnership, Jadhav then played his part in the middle overs and then Bumrah contributed towards the end. There were a few dropped chances and some sloppy fielding efforts, but fortunately for them, none were costly.

A clinical show with the ball from the Indians, that too after being asked to bowl. Barring that 82-run stand between Azam and Malik, nobody put up any kind of a fight, not worth anything of note at least. The two openers were sent back early by Kumar, but then the Azam-Malik stand provided good resistance and shored things up too. Though, the moment Kuldeep got rid of Babar, things went downhill from there for the Men in Green. Wickets kept falling and eventually, they were rolled up for a low score.

OUT! Bowled 'em! And that's the end of that. PAKISTAN HAVE BEEN WRAPPED UP FOR 162! Bumrah, typically, spears in an accurate yorker and aims it at the base of off stump. Too good for Usman Khan who can't do anything about it. It goes under his bat and the off stick is shaken. Jasprit celebrates like Shahid Afridi with his hands aloft. Superb stuff.
Brings out the short one and hits the deck hard. It's coming in and Mohammad Amir ducks in time to evade it.
Angles it in by continuing from around the wicket, Amir defends it gently on the off side.
Outside off on a good length, left alone.
Shortish delivery outside the line of off stump, Amir rides the bounce and opens the face before steering it behind point for a brace.
Kumar goes fuller, keeps it around off and it's driven to the man at extra cover.
Usman Khan is the last man in for Pakistan.

OUT! A simple catch and Hasan Ali walks back to the dressing room. Bhuvneshwar bowls a length ball on the stumps, Ali stands tall and tries to clear mid on. Doesn't exactly get on top of the bounce and so, lobs it towards Dinesh Karthik who takes a few steps behind to gobble it up.
Amir shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a good length outside off, Amir opens the face of the bat and pushes it to point.
Off the mark with that. Full ball outside off, Hasan drives it through the covers for a single.
Fires in the yorker, accurately on off, Hasan Ali does well to bring his bat down in time and jam it out.
Full in length and outside off, cracked through towards sweeper cover for a run.
Hasan Ali to bat next.

OUT! Ashraf holes out, but not before contributing to a handy partnership of 37 for Pakistan. Bumrah strikes first ball on his return to the attack. Comes from around the wicket and bowls a slower one, full in length. Ashraf swings across the line but fails to pick it up. As a result, he skies it over mid-wicket and Dhawan out in the deep takes a safe catch.
Jasprit Bumrah returns to the bowling attack.
On the leg stump line, goes off the pads of the batsman and falls on the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
Marginally ahead of a length on middle and off, Faheem stands tall and attempts to slog it over mid-wicket, but instead gets it off the inner half in the same region.
Just behind a length, outside off, cut hard to point.
Goes fuller on this occasion, it's driven to mid on.

Bhuvi appeals loudly but it's clearly pitching outside leg. Not sure what the fuss was about. Length ball pitching outside leg and then it hits Ashraf on the pads in line of the stumps. The umpire sees that and doesn't respond to the appeal.
Good length delivery shaping away from around off, played to point.
Powerplay 3 signalled. A maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the end of the innings. Also, Bhuvneshwar Kumar is brought back on. Can he break this useful stand?
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
A lot of flight again, on off, Ashraf looks to flick across the line and it pops off the edge towards short third man.
A bit wider outside off, spinning away again, the batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Tossed up delivery spinning away, Faheem with a front foot defensive shot.

FOUR LEG BYES! A bit lucky, but the runs are what matter and Pakistan will accept them gleefully. Kuldeep tosses it up there, Ashraf tries to flick but misses and it goes off his pads past the off stump and MS Dhoni. Races away to the third man fence, beating the chasing fielder.
A lot of revs as Kuldeep lands it full on the stumps, driven through mid off for a single.
Kuldeep Yadav returns.
Pushed away to the cover region to end the over.
Straighter one, flicked towards mid-wicket.
A bit of a misfield allows the batsmen to take some runs. Ashraf slaps it towards extra cover and the fumble concedes two.
Short, flat and close to the off stick, Ashraf watches the ball and blocks it to the off side.
Spears in a full delivery attacking the stumps, driven through mid on for one run.
Starts from around the wicket and slides it in on off, Mohammad Amir goes back and defends.
Driven hard, but right at the mid off fielder.
Takes a big stride forward and keeps it out well.
FOUR! Takes a bit of risk but it pays off. This is a good shot from Faheem Ashraf. Sees the ball landing full around off, Ashraf opens his body up and lofts it cleanly over the covers for a boundary.
Slower through the air outside off, full in length, eased back down to long off for a single.

In the air... but it falls safely! Chahal flights it up well on the stumps and Amir goes down to play the big slog sweep. Skies it in the mid-wicket region as Dhawan comes running in from the deep. It falls just short of him as the batsmen take two.
Loopy and full on middle and leg, Amir tries to flick but it goes off his pads on the off side.
Quicker one, sliding in on leg on a fuller length, strikes Ashraf low on the pads as he fails to play the flick shot.
Short again, Amir offers a firm punch down to long on and crosses over.
Another defensive shot presented, but this time off the front foot.
Darted it quicker around off, shorter in length, Amir defends it right under his eyes.
Full in length, around off, it's lofted over the bowler's head towards long off for a run.
Short and wide, not much turn on this occasion, Amir camps on the back foot and cuts it square through point for a single.
Spinning in, a bit too much though. On middle and leg, and hence, the ball is going down leg. The ball rapped the batsman on the pads, so the appeal is turned down quickly.
Stays back and keeps it out off the back foot.

Dropped! He should have taken that. Relatively easy chance for the leggie. Tossed up on the stumps, Ashraf drives it on the up right back towards the bowler. Chahal moves to his right and gets his hands to it, but can't hold on.
Comes forward and blocks it well.
The catch is taken but to no avail. Full outside off, Amir gets low and slogs across the line. Into the hands of Kuldeep at wide long on and he throws it back in as the batsmen take a run.

No ball! Rare to see it from a spinner. Chahal oversteps as he bowls a full ball outside off, driven to long off for one more. Free Hit coming up. It wasn't a no ball though, as the replays show. A bit harsh on Chahal.
A lot of air provided here, full outside off, driven to long off for a single.
Yuzvendra Chahal is called back to bowl.
Another back foot punch, past the diving extra cover fielder. Single to end the over.
Sliding in on a bit of a shorter length, Ashraf backs away and slaps the punch through the vacant spaces in the cover region. One to the total.
Oh! A bit risky as it could have gone right through. A bit too full as Amir tries to sweep. Connects, but barely. It's away on the leg side for one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Quicker one outside off, hit with a punch through the covers for a single.
Slower through the air and drifting in around off, Ashraf prods forward and pushes it tamely on the off side.
Back of a length on off, Amir presents a defensive bat in response.

Edged and FOUR! A slip was there in place but just too wide. Full and outside off, Amir plays the expansive drive and gets a thick edge. Flies between Dhoni and Dhawan at wide first slip. Shikhar dives to his right but can't get to it. A boundary results.
Amir rises and taps this short of a good length ball to cover-point. Dot ball.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, pulled with a little swivel through square leg for one.
Rising off the deck on a good length, takes Faheem by surprise a bit and raps him on the thigh pad.
FOUR! Full in length and outside off, some room to work with and Ashraf pounces on it. Drives it nicely through the covers and finds the fence.

Drinks break. During the previous drinks break, Pakistan were in control. At this time, they've totally lost it. India have made a serious comeback with some smart and disciplined bowling from the spinners. From 85/2, they went to 121/7. All this after some dropped chances too. India on top here. Also, Mohammad Amir is the new man in.

OUT! Not really a surprise why Shadab decided to walk. If Dhoni's sure, then you're more or less gone. Khan decides to give the charge and seeing this, Jadhav shortens the length and fires it outside off. It goes past the outside edge and Dhoni, lightning as always, whips the bails off in a flash. It's taken upstairs and replays show that Shadab couldn't drag his back leg inside in time. That's the end of that.
A stumping referral against Shadab Khan is being checked upstairs by the umpire. The batsman is already walking. Probably says a lot in itself.
Fuller and straighter in line of the stumps, blocked safely.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. They pick up a single.
Eased down to long off for a comfortable single.
Too straight in line, Khan works it off his pads for no run.
Short and flat outside off, kept out off the back foot.

Safe! Height is an issue and it saves Ashraf. Around the wicket to Faheem, back of a length coming in on middle and leg, the batsman fails to flick and wears it on the thigh pad. A loud appeal goes up but it's denied. Rohit Sharma thinks on what to do, asks Dhoni who says he's unsure, but he anyway goes ahead with it and reviews it. Replays show it's too high and missing the stumps. India lose their review.
Review taken. It's for an lbw decision against Faheem Ashraf. Height maybe an issue. Let's see...
Angling back in on middle and leg, full in length, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Play and a miss! A loosener as Bumrah bowls it full and wide outside off, Shadab reaches out to play at it but misses.
On a length and in the off stump channel, going away, Ashraf pushes it tamely towards cover-point and gets to the other end.
Full again from Bumrah, makes it go across the southpaw, Faheem once again drives it to the mid off fielder.
Almost a yorker, slanting across, Faheem drills it but straight to the man at mid off.
Jasprit Bumrah is back on.
Finds the gap well. Shadab punches this off the back foot through the gap in the covers and comes back for the second.
On the shorter side of things, blocked.
Stands firm inside the crease and meets it with a defensive blade in response.
Drifting in from around off, Ashraf backs away and cuts it square to point for a single.
Tap and run stuff from Khan. Works it down in front of covers and scampers to the other end. Nicely done.
Fuller, faster and straighter on the stumps, it's driven square to point off the outer half.
Full and loopy outside off, comfortably driven through the gap in the covers for a couple.
A back foot punch to long off and a single results.
The wrong 'un from Kuldeep, rising with some extra bounce, Shadab somehow manages to play it back to the bowler. Unable to pick the chinaman well here.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Stays inside the crease again and works it with the spin on the leg side.
Turning into the batsman from middle and off, Shadab goes back and turns it away on the leg side.
Another solid defense from Faheem Ashraf. A wicket maiden for Jadhav. Amazing stuff.
Leans across to get right behind the line and defends.
Fullish in length and around off, kept out safely from the front foot.

Loud shout, but a big inside edge and that's a good spot by Marais Erasmus. Coming in from around off, it keeps really low and raps Faheem Ashraf on the pads. Luckily for him, there's involvement from the willow which saves him.
From around the wicket, Kedar offers room outside off by bowling it short, Ashraf cuts it straight to short third man.
Faheem Ashraf walks into the middle next.

OUT! Got 'em! Asif Ali's brief stay has come to an end. He's a dangerous player, India have taken a crucial wicket as he can go big towards the end after settling in. Jadhav darts it short and flat outside off, Ali looks to fiercely cut it away on the off side but can only manage a feather to Dhoni, who takes a sharp catch.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.

SIX! He can do that. He's known to do that and he's doing it now here too. Flighted delivery outside off, Asif Ali kneels down and throws the kitchen sink at it. Powers it over long on and sends it deep into the stands for a maximum.
Stays inside the crease and keeps it out safely.
Flat and short outside off, punched off the back foot down to long off for one more.
Plays this full ball with the spin and wrists it down to long on for a single.
Spinning in on middle and leg, Shadab goes on the back foot and works it down towards fine leg for a single.
Shadab Khan is the new man in.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Pakistan have lost their way big time. Malik was batting pretty well and he will be disappointed with himself. Ali taps this one towards cover-point and is watching the ball. Malik however charges in from the other end. Realizing that, Ali tells his partner to go back. Malik in order to avoid the throw turns around and runs across the wickets. Rayudu attacks the ball, picks it up and hits the bull's eye at the bowler's end as Shoaib tries to drag his bat back in. It is referred upstairs. Time for replays. Well, Malik is well short of where he needed to be. He was lazy to return back which cost him. If he had ran in straighter lines, he might have been able to make his ground. The Men in Green have lost half their side now.
Direct hit from Ambati Rayudu! Seems Shoaib Malik is in trouble. Going to be real close. Over to the TV umpire now...
Shorter in length, punched out off the back foot.
Flatter one outside off, keeps low too. Ali tries to cut it away but misses.
On the shorter side of things, placed towards point for a single. 100 comes up for Pakistan.
Nicely bowled! This one drifts away as Ali tries to push it down the ground but edges it towards short third man. A single taken.
Low full toss on middle, Malik drives it down to long on for a single.
Tucks this one with the spin through square leg for a single.
Shorter delivery, cut away uppishly but falls well short of the man at covers.
Slower through the air, kept out watchfully.
On a flatter trajectory, tucked towards square leg.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
Tossed up ball, defended solidly off the front foot.
Hangs back to the shorter ball and keeps it out. A productive over for Jadhav.
Asif Ali strides out to bat. Meanwhile, umpire Marais Erasmus is waiting to check whether the batsmen crossed. They didn't cross eventually and Ali will be on strike.

OUT! Take a bow, Manish Pandey! That is a gem of a catch. Malik's opportunity was missed in the previous over but this time the substitute, Pandey, has come to the fore. Tossed up fullish ball on off, Ahmed clears his front leg and slogs it towards wide long on. Manish covers a lot of ground to his right, keeps his balance intact and takes it brilliantly with both his hands. He realizes that the momentum is taking him over the ropes and hence, lobs the ball back into play. He crosses the boundary and then comes in to collect it. His teammates barge towards him. This is a good phase of play for India and they will like to make hay while the sun shines.
Good placement! Short ball outside off, Ahmed manages to cut it past the point region. Dhawan hares after it and by the time he cuts it off, the batsmen take a couple.
The round-arm action of Jadhav is not easy getting used to it. He bowls a flatter one outside off, Ahmed tries to cut it through point but gets beaten.
Slower through the air, tucked with ease through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker and flatter one on middle and leg, punched away with the spin to mid-wicket.
Down the ground again, this time towards long on and another single is collected.
Sarfraz eases this full length delivery through to long off and gets to the other end.

Oh, dear! Bhuvneshwar Kumar has completely missed that. Shoaib Malik is offered another life. He gives the charge to this floated ball and slogs over mid-wicket. Plenty of height, not enough distance and Bhuvneshwar is out in the deep. The setting sun's in his eye and as a result, he loses it and runs too far inside. Sunglasses are there for a reason, should have opted for them when they are so freely available. One taken.
Dropped short and flat outside off, it's the googly, Malik stays back and runs it late down towards third man. Gets an easy couple for doing so.
A lot of loop on this, full on middle and leg, wristed to short mid-wicket for nothing.
Tossed up delivery on the stumps, driven easily to long off for a single.
Camps back and clips it with the spin through square leg for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Short ball outside off, cut away towards point.
Almost! Jadhav spots Ahmed using his feet and bowls a flatter one outside off. Sarfraz just manages to get an inside edge onto his pads which saves him.
Hangs back to the shorter ball and tucks it with a closed bat face towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on middle, eased off the front foot to mid on.
Kedar Jadhav to have a bowl now.
Tossed up outside off, pushed towards point. A successful over for India.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Full on middle, pushed down the track.
Ahmed brings out his favoured sweep shot right into play and plays it through square leg for a single to get off the mark.
The Pakistan skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed, is the new man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Kuldeep has completely bamboozled Azam this time and boy, he is absolutely pumped up. He slips in the googly around middle and leg and it dips on Babar as well. He is down the track but has no clue about it as he feels it is the conventional leg spinner. Tries to flick it across with the spin but misses it completely to get the bails of his stumps dislodged. He looks back and thinks that Dhoni has lost the ball and he has a chance to come back in. However, he realizes that the ball had hit the timber. End of the flourishing 82-run stand and also the good knock from Azam. Can India trigger a collapse now?
Tossed up delivery, kept out watchfully.
Similar delivery, knocked down to long on for another run.
Slower through the air, Malik tucks it with a closed bat face through mid on for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter ball this time, punched off the back foot through covers for a run.
Fuller in length outside off, Azam frees his arms and square drives it behind point. A couple taken.
Tossed up generously in line of the stumps, tucked towards mid-wicket.
Fired in on the leg stump line, tucked around the corner for a single.
Waits for the ball to arrive and clips it with the spin to the leg side for a single.
Quicker one on middle, Shoaib makes a bit of room and punches it to covers.
Kuldeep drags his length back. Malik has enough time to dead-bat it.
Full loopy delivery on off, Babar leans ahead and eases it to long off to rotate strike.
Floated delivery, milked down to long on for a run.
Kuldeep Yadav comes back into the attack.
Lands on middle and off and skids after pitching. Malik hangs back and knocks it down to long on for a single. 3 from the over, tidy stuff from Chahal.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Tossed up ball, defended solidly off the front foot.

A direct hit would have made things interesting! Tossed up on middle and leg, Azam taps it towards square leg and calls his partner through. Dhoni attacks the ball, turns back but as he throws the ball, he loses his balance and the shy goes well wide at his end. Malik was struggling there.
The wrong one from Chahal. Malik camps back to tuck it across but seems to have missed it. The ball kisses his pads and rolls to square leg. A leg bye taken.
Floated delivery on middle and leg, turning away. Malik hangs back and keeps it out.
Shorter in length outside off, cut away to the man at point.

Well, not good news for India. Hardik is lying on the stretcher and is being carried off the field. Doesn't look good at all at the moment. While landing on his followthrough, his right foot lost balance. Seems like he has hurt his hip region. Ravi Shastri looks concerned in the dressing room. A big blow for the Men in Blue. Meanwhile, Ambati Rayudu will bowl the final ball of the over in Pandya's place.

What happened there? Hardik Pandya has fallen on the ground after delivering the ball. Seems to be in a lot of pain. The replays show that he lost his footing a bit on his followthrough. Might have pulled his hamstring. India will hope that it is nothing serious.
On a length outside off, played with soft hands towards covers.
Full ball outside off, tapped to cover-point for a quick run.
Back of a length outside off, glided down to third man for a single.
On a length on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! Good shot! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Azam leans into it and caresses it through covers. Rayudu has a lot of ground to cover. He runs to his right, slides full length and almost pulls it back in but his legs come in the way. Deflects to the ropes off the boots. Unlucky there.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, worked towards square leg for a run.
Good placement from Malik! On a shorter length, Malik hangs back and whips it through mid-wicket. It is in the gap and the batsmen get three runs.
On a flatter trajectory and shorter in length, knocked down to long on for another run.
Slower through the air, Malik leans ahead and drives it through covers for a single.
Azam gets to the pitch of the delivery and eases it through mid on to rotate strike.
Tossed up on middle and leg, tucked with a closed bat face towards mid-wicket.

Time for Drinks! It has been a really good recovery from Pakistan, courtesy the unbeaten 50-run stand between Malik and Azam. The Men in Green had lost a couple of early wickets but these two have shown a lot of composure. The scoring rate for Pakistan was under 3 in Powerplay 1 but they picked up pace later on, going around 6 an over in the next six. The dropped catch of Malik just before the break will not help India's cause. They need to take their chances.

Dropped! Dhoni won't be happy with that! Good length ball outside off, straightens a touch after landing. Malik attempts to guide it down to third man but ends up playing it too fine and towards MS. He gets low to his right and the ball hits his right glove. On impact with the ground, the ball lobs up, hits his other glove and then dies down on the ground. Malik gets a life. Will he capitalize on it?
Length ball outside off, placed past point for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Pitched up ball, driven nicely towards mid on.
Another run stolen! These two have been astute in this area. Short ball outside off, guided towards backward point to change strike.
Short and room on offer, cut away towards third man for a single.
Loopy delivery in line of the stumps, turned towards mid-wicket.

Better from Chahal! Slows the pace on this one and bowls it on the middle and leg line. Malik clears his front leg to keep it out but is foxed by the googly. Gets an inside edge onto his pads eventually.
Takes a step forward and milks it down to long on to change strike.
On the shorter side of things, Babar camps back and blocks it down the track.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated outside off, driven with the spin through covers to rotate strike.
Chahal is back on.

FOUR! Deft and effective! Short of a length and there is room on offer, Azam shows finesse as he waits for the ball to arrive and glides it past the keeper through to the third man fence. That brings up the 50-run stand between the duo. A good recovery after Pakistan lost two early wickets.
On a flatter trajectory, kept out watchfully.
Shortish ball outside off, guided towards the gully region. Azam wants a run but there is none on offer and he is sent back. Good awareness from the backward point fielder.
Nicely done! Back of a length well outside off, Malik dabs it towards backward point. Azam calls his partner through for a run and he responds well.
Full length ball again, just outside off, Malik taps it square of the wicket on the off side.
Full ball outside off, eased through covers for an easy single.
Full loopy ball around off, Azam leans ahead and knocks it down to long off for a run. Expensive start from Kuldeep, 10 from his first over.
Spinning into Shoaib as he drives it through mid on to rotate strike.

SIX! Clean as a whistle! That was hit with so much authority. Tossed up ball on off, Malik skips down the track in a jiffy and with a high backlift tonks it over cow corner. Has sent the ball a long, long way into the stands. Brilliant.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Well bowled! Slower through the air on middle, dips on the batsman. He is cramped for room and bunts it out towards covers.
Starts off with a tossed up ball on leg stump, Malik hangs back and tucks it around the corner for a single.

Kuldeep Yadav to have a bowl now. He has a truck load of tricks up his sleeve. Let's see how the Pakistan batsmen tackle him. Laxman Sivaramakrishnan on air informs that Chahal is off the field. Not sure about the reason though.
FOUR! All about timing and grace! Overpitched on middle, Azam stays well-balanced and clips it nonchalantly through mid-wicket. Don't need to chase those.

Typical Shoaib Malik shot! It is a percentage one for him and fetches him a lot of runs. Shortish ball and there is room on offer, Malik rises on his toes and with a free flow of the bat upper cuts it towards deep backward point. A run taken.
Short ball on off but there is very little pace on this track to trouble the batsman. He stands tall and pulls it over mid-wicket. Bumrah in the deep cuts it off. A couple taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full length ball outside off this time, carved away with an open bat face to the point fielder.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Malik puts his head down and defends it calmly.

FOUR! Poor delivery and gets the treatment! A half-tracker outside off, Azam makes good use of the depth of the crease and slaps it past the cover fielder. Beats the man in the deep as well to pick up another boundary. 7 from Chahal's first over.
Chahal needs to bowl fuller. Once again it is too short and Shoaib has ample time to rock back and tuck it towards square leg. A run taken.
Allows the ball to come towards him and defends it nicely.
On the shorter side of things, cut away with the spin to sweeper cover to rotate strike.
Tossed up ball on off, Babar uses his feet but gets too close to the pitch of it. Can only drive it back towards the bowler.
Starts off with a short ball outside off, Malik cuts it towards backward point. The fielder dives to his left but fails to stop it cleanly. A run results.
Time for Powerplay 2! Maximum of four fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Meanwhile, Yuzvendra Chahal to roll his arm over now.
The slower ball from Pandya outside off, Azam hangs back and pushes it towards point. A really good Powerplay 1 for India. They will be aiming to keep the pressure on Pakistan.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Babar eases it towards covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
This is what they need to do, keep the scoreboard ticking. Malik leans ahead to push it towards cover-point and scurries across to the other end.
Good communication between the two! Azam plays it with an angled bat towards point and takes off. Has a look at his partner who responds well and they complete it nicely.
Starts off with a fullish ball around off, Azam comes ahead and defends it nicely.
Hardik Pandya to bowl now.
Angling in from a length outside off, Shoaib tucks it towards mid-wicket. Only a run from the over, Kumar continues to be frugal.
Fuller in length on middle and off, Malik shows the full face of the bat and pushes it down the track.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Pitched up ball on the fifth stump channel, Malik comes ahead to block it nicely.
Good game awareness again! Taps the good length ball towards mid on and calls his partner through for a brisk run. Took on Kuldeep and got away with it with ease.
On a good length around off, Azam comes forward and defends it nicely towards covers.
Good length ball closer to the off stump, kept out watchfully.

That's a peach! Cut Shoaib into two halves. Lands on a good length outside off and curves in after landing. Malik tries to defend it but the ball goes through the gap between his bat and pad and into the mitts of the keeper.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Good running! Slower ball outside off, Malik taps it towards covers and scampers across to the other end.
Back of a length outside off, played with an open bat face towards the point region.
On a length, angling in, defended off the back foot towards the off side.
Outside off, Azam plays at it but misses.
Length ball around off, defended from the comfort of the crease.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Another eye-catching stroke. On a length outside off, Azam stands tall and caresses it through covers to find the fence again.

FOUR! That will do his confidence a world of good! A brilliant shot. In the corridor of uncertainty, Azam comes forward and just pushes at it. The ball hits the turf and races across to the long off fence.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Azam is itching to get going! Back of a length ball outside off, comes off slowly after landing. Azam goes at it with hard hands but mistimes it towards mid on.
Similar length ball outside off, Shoaib shuffles a touch and pats it to cover-point. Better over for Pakistan, 8 from this one.
Back of a length, angling in, tucked with a closed bat face towards mid on for a single.
Rush of blood from Azam! Good length ball well outside off, Azam chases it away from his body and tries to drive it on the up but misses.
Bumrah does the mistake of bowling this one too straight. Malik clips it nicely through mid-wicket and gets three good runs for it.

FOUR! Sit back and applaud! Everything was perfect about that shot - head position, high elbow and extension of the arms. Pitched up ball outside off, Malik reaches the pitch of the ball and drives it elegantly through covers to find the fence. First boundary of the innings as well.
Overpitched on middle and off, driven crisply to mid on.
On a length in the tight off stump channel, defended solidly off the back foot. Another tidy over, 1 from it. Giving no breathing space to Pakistan.

Back of a length outside off, Malik taps it behind backward point and calls for a run. There is a bit of hesitation initially but eventually they trust each other and Babar makes it home, beating the throw.
Full ball, angling in from outside off, Shoaib with his bat and pad close together drives it to mid on. Had it covered there.
Short of a length outside off, Malik camps back and taps it towards covers.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Shoaib Malik strides out to bat.

OUT! Another poor shot has cost Pakistan big time! Both the openers are back in the hut in no time. Even though you are in rich vein of form, you got to respect the conditions and take your time to settle in. One poor execution can send you packing. Coming back to the ball, it is on a shortish length on off. Zaman doesn't have much space to work with but still goes for a big pull across the line. Ends up getting a top edge that lobs over mid-wicket. Chahal backtracks and takes a fine catch. This is the first duck for Fakhar in ODI cricket. The maiden over that Bumrah bowled put Zaman under pressure. Credit to the Indian bowlers as they kept on cramping him and didn't give him any space to work with. Rohit Sharma is elated and so are his teammates! Pakistan in some early trouble. Need to remain patient.
Bumrah hits the deck hard and generates good purchase from the deck. Azam hops and defends it down the track. Another maiden from Bumrah, he is on a roll.
Short of a length delivery on middle, kept out with a straight bat.
Similar delivery on an identical length, punched crisply off the back foot square of the wicket on the off side.
On the sixth stump channel, played with an angled bat towards point.
Full ball on middle, tapped off the front foot to mid on.
Overpitched outside off, Babar drives it on the bounce to Pandya at point. He lobs the ball up and starts to celebrate. Has a wry smile on his face after that, confused the crowd there.
Pitched up delivery, Zaman comes forward and defends it nicely. A wicket and a run from the over.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Lazy from the Indians! Back of a length outside off, Babar taps it towards point. The fielder is casual there and misfields. The cover-point fielder makes a mess of it too to concede  a run. Azam is off the mark with that.
On a length in line of the stumps, Azam stands tall and blocks it nicely.
Full ball on off, kept out watchfully.
Babar Azam comes out to bat.

OUT! Kumar is up and running! He was off color in the previous game against Hong Kong but he has come out firing on all cylinders today. He spots Imam using his feet and hence, shortens his length. Hits the deck hard as the batsman swings wildly at it. Ends up getting a thick outside edge though and Dhoni behind the stumps does the rest. That was a poor shot, the youngster will be kicking himself. Fails in his first outing against India. It was a surprising shot selection from him though. He usually takes his time to get in but today he perished attempting to do something extravagant.
Fractionally overpitched on middle and leg, driven hard but straight to mid on. Brilliant start from Bumrah, a maiden.
Bumrah spots Zaman taking a few steps down the track and bowls a high full toss aimed at him. He tries to hit it too hard and mistimes it back towards the bowler. A maiden on the cards?

Four dots in a row! Back of a length ball, a touch straighter this time. Zaman is on his toes as he tries to defend it. He does block it but not convincingly. It was more of a fend towards mid-wicket.
Same line and length from Bumrah in the off stump corridor. Fakhar puts his head down and defends it besides the pitch on the off side.
Bumrah pitches this one up again and there is a bit of nibble in the air. Zaman leans ahead and blocks it with authority.
Zaman is showing intent straightaway! Pitched up ball around off, Zaman makes a bit of room, clears his front leg and drills it but finds the extra cover fielder.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Length ball that swings into the batsman who covers the line and tucks it towards mid-wicket. Decent start for Bhuvi and India, only 2 from the first over.
A bit tentative! Back of a length and some width on offer, Imam tries to force it off the back foot through covers but ends up getting it off the inner half down the track.
Stump-to-stump line and on a length, Imam hangs back and blocks it with authority.

Pakistan and Imam are underway! In search of extravagant swing, Bhuvi ends up bowling it on a length on the hips. Imam moves inside the line and tucks it in front of square leg. Chahal gives it a chase and keeps the batsmen down to a couple.
Pitches this one fuller outside off, Imam-ul-Haq leans ahead a touch and taps it towards cover-point.
Right on the money is Bhuvneshwar! Bowls it on a good length around off and gets some inward movement. Imam shuffles a touch and blocks it down the track.

The players come out to the middle for their respective national anthems. After the completion, we are all set to roll. Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq will open the batting for Pakistan. They are in rich vein of form and will be eager to capitalize on it. Bhuvneshwar Kumar will steam in with the first new ball. A slip in place. Here we go...

India skipper, Rohit Sharma, says that they would have batted first as well but nevertheless they know what they are doing now. Adds that they will play their upcoming games at the same ground and it is nice that they will chase today. Credits Hong Kong for the way they played in the last game but is happy that they were successful in getting over the line. Feels that it will be a fantastic game against Pakistan and they are all geared up for it. Informs there are two changes - Jasprit Bumrah comes in for Shardul Thakur and Khaleel Ahmed makes way for Hardik Pandya.

Pakistan skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed, says that they will bat first today. Informs that they are going in with the same eleven that featured in their last game. Mentions that it is a good batting pitch and they want to put India under pressure. Ends by saying that they will target to put up a score above 280.
TOSS - Sarfraz Ahmed calls heads and the coin lands in his favour. Pakistan opt to bat.

PITCH REPORT - Sunil Gavaskar says that the same pitch which was used yesterday is being used today as well. Mentions that there are no footmarks on the surface and there is no damage inflicted on it. Adds that the ball is expected to come onto the bat but a little slowly. Feels that the bowlers won't enjoy bowling here much while the batsmen will have a good time. Reminds that Kuldeep Yadav and Yuzvendra Chahal got some turn yesterday but it is a good batting pitch overall.

Shikhar Dhawan is being interviewed on the sidelines. He says that they were in England for a long time and those were difficult conditions. Adds that his best was not good enough there but he didn't lose his self-belief. States that he came back into the nets, worked hard and is happy to have scored a ton in the last game against Hong Kong. Mentions that he believes in his process and wants to keep going strong. Adds that from the last two months he hadn't scored a half century or century and he wanted to perform well. Ends by saying that it was important for him to get amongst the runs before the game against Pakistan.

Pakistan, on the other hand, are high on confidence at the moment. They hardly broke a sweat against Hong Kong and the fact that they won the finals of the 2017 Champions Trophy against their arch-rivals, India, gives them a psychological edge. They have a well-balanced team and will be banking on their bowlers again. These two sides have already made it to the Top Four and it might help them to express themselves with a lot of freedom. Expect a cracker!

India were in danger of facing an upset against Hong Kong last evening but their experience came to the fore. It is not easy to play back-to-back games especially in such hot conditions and that will test the fitness of the players. Their middle order woes are a big concern for them. It will be in the limelight again and it will be interesting to see how they deal with the massive pressure. We might see a few changes in the Indian set-up. KL Rahul might come in place of Dinesh Karthik while Jasprit Bumrah is almost certain to replace an out of touch Shardul Thakur.

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of the mother of all battles, India vs Pakistan. Whenever these two teams compete, there is a lot at stake. Jam-packed stadiums and people shouting at the top of their voices add to the charm of the contest. Today will be no different. In the Asia Cup, these two have faced each other 11 times with the Men in Blue winning 6 times, including the sole game in the T20I version while the Men in Green have emerged victorious on 5 occasions.
